coordinate.temporal_order: monotone evidence pruning after one provider attempt
coordinate.persistence_lifetime: OUTCOME_UNKNOWN until singleton verified/failure or quarantine
coordinate.selection_rule: minimize worst-case surviving worlds then observation cost
coordinate.broadcast_granularity: none by default; only unresolved/urgent alert may enter GWT
coordinate.reentry_structure: singleton verified outcome -> provenance-bound UnifiedDB re-entry -> DONE
coordinate.causal_credit_path: attempt identity -> provider evidence -> verified outcome -> semantic delta
coordinate.resource_allocation: bounded world count and observation catalog

collision_avoidance.ECT-001: CEA does not infer unresolved CallContracts; consumes exact contract or stops.
collision_avoidance.SCF-001: CEA does not replace semantic charge/integrity checks.
collision_avoidance.CJC-001: CEA does not schedule effect writes; CJC may later optimize independent reads.
